description: Stable list of churn-prone paths for coupling git-history churn metrics with white-box tooling. Pair with churn stats (commits/lines/files per window) keyed by path prefixes.

hotspots.rationale: Tier, tax, and coupon nests change often; correlate high churn here with weaker all-uses manifests.
Authorization branches (wallet tolerance, throttle) are churn magnets for regressions.
Intentionally volatile control flow for def-use / all-uses tooling studies.
Dynamic pricing merges schedule hints and scarcity; churn often skips tests.
Checkout and loyalty ordering drive subtle side effects.
